Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች በደቡብ አፍሪካ እና በኒውዚላንድ ያሉ ሰዎች የትንበያ አገልግሎቶችን እንዴት እንደሚጠቀሙ ለማየት መርጠዋል - ሁለቱም አገሮች ረጅም የባህር ዳርቻዎች አሏቸው፣ ግን እጅግ በጣም የተለያዩ የህዝብ ብዛቶች እና የባህር ዳርቻዎች አሏቸው።

Source: They wanted to find out how often these coastal citizens use national or commercial forecasting services, for what purposes and whether they found these useful and trustworthy.
Luganda: Baayagala okuzuula ddi abatuuze b’oku mbalama zino lwe bakozesa okuteebereza okukolebwa eggwanga n’ebitongole by’obusuubuzi, lwaki bakukozesa era oba ng’okuteebereza kuno bakusanga nga kwa mugaso era nga kwesigika.
Yoruba: Wọn fẹ́ mọ iye ìgbà tí àwọn olùgbé ìgbèrí òkun wọ̀nyí máa ń ṣe àmúlò iṣẹ́ àpètẹ́lẹ̀ orílẹ̀ èdè tàbí ti oníṣòwò, fún irúfẹ́ àwọn ìdí wo, àti pé, bóyá èyí wúlò fún wọn tà̀bí wọn gbàgbọ́ nínú rẹ̀.
Zulu: Babefuna ukuthola ukuthi lezi zakhamuzi zasogwini zizisebenzisa kaningi kangakanani izibikezelo zezwe noma zezentengiselwano, ngaziphi izinjongo nokuthi zithole ziwusizo futhi zithembekile yini.
Hausa: Suna son gano sau nawa waɗannan ’yan ƙasa na bakin teku suke amfani da ayyuka na hasashen yanayi na ƙasa ko na kasuwanci, domin waɗanne dalilai kuma ko sun sami waɗannan masu amfani da kuma aminci.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba nyaka go utolla gore ke makga a makae moo badudi ba ba tikologong ya lewatle ba šomišago ditirelo tša kakanyo ya boso tša bosetšhaba goba tša kgwebo, gore ke tša merero efe le ge e ba ba hweditše di na le mohola ebile di botega.
Amharic: እነዚህ የባህር ዳርቻ ዜጎች ለምን ያህል ጊዜ ብሄራዊ ወይም የንግድ ትንበያ አገልግሎቶችን እንደሚጠቀሙ፣ ለምን ዓላማዎች እና እነዚህ ጠቃሚ እና ታማኝ ሆነው እንዳገኙ ለማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር።

Source: These are important factors in light of how future climate change might impact weather forecasting.
Luganda: Zino nsonga nkulu mu kulaba engeri enkyukakyuka z’embeera y’obudde mu biseera by’omu maaso gye ziyinza okukosaamu okuteebereza embeera y'obudde.
Yoruba: Ẹ̀yí jẹ́ àwọn okùnfà pàtàkì ní ìtọnà bí àyipadà ojú ọjọ́ ní ọjọ́ iwájú ṣe lè ní ipa lórí ṣíṣe àpètẹ́lẹ̀ ojú ọjọ́.
Zulu: Lezi izinto ezibalulekile uma kucatshangelwa ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu esizayo kungase kube nomthelela kanjani ekubikezelweni kwesimo sezulu.
Hausa: Waɗannan abubuwa ne masu mahimmanci dangane da yadda sauyin yanayi na gaba zai iya tasiri ga hasashen yanayi.
Northern Sotho: Tše ke dintlha tše bohlokwa go lebeletšwe ka moo phetogo ya klaemete ya ka moso e ka amago kakanyo ya boso.
Amharic: እነዚህ ነገሮች ከወደፊቱ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ አንፃር የአየር ሁኔታ ትንበያ እንዴት ሊጎዳ እንደሚችል አስፈላጊ መነሻ ምክንያቶች ናቸው።

Source: In online questionnaire was answered by 31 South Africans and 126 New Zealanders.
Luganda: Ebibuuzo eby’oku yintaneeti byayanukulwa abantu b’omu South Afirika 31 n’ab’omu New Zealand 126.

Zulu: Uhla lwemibuzo oluku-inthanethi luphendulwe abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abanga-31 kanye nabaseNew Zealand abayi-126.

Northern Sotho: Lenaneopotšišo la dinyakišišo la inthaneteng le arabilwe ke badudi ba 31 ba Afrika Borwa le ba 126 ba New Zealand.
Amharic: የመስመር ላይ መጠይቁ በ31 ደቡብ አፍሪካውያን እና 126 ኒውዚላንድ ተወላጆች ተመልሷል።

Source: These included people who use weather forecasts for work purposes (for instance fishermen and search and rescue organisations), and others who take part in ocean-related sports and leisure activities such as surfing, paddling, or swimming.
Luganda: Mu bano mwalimu abantu abakozesa okuteebereza embeera y’obudde mu mirimu gyabwe (okugeza abavubi n’ebitongole ebinoonya n’okutaasa abantu), n’abalala abeenyigira mu mizannyo n’okwewummuza eby’oku ssemayanja nga okutambulira mu mayengo, okuvuga obwato, oba okuwuga.
Yoruba: Èyí pẹ̀lú àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ń ṣe àmúlò àpètẹ́lẹ̀ ojú ọjọ́ fún iṣẹ́ ṣíṣe (fún àpẹẹrẹ, àwọn apẹja àti àwọn ikọ̀ tí ó wà fún ìdóòlá ẹ̀mí lórí omi), àti àwọn mìíràn tí wọ́n kópa nínú eré ìdárayá àti ìgbáfẹ́ tí ó jẹ mọ́ òkun bii sọ́fìn, wíwa ọkọ orí omi pẹlú igi, tàbí lílúwẹ̀ nínú omi.
Zulu: Lokhu kuhlanganisa abantu abasebenzisa izibikezelo zesimo sezulu ngezinjongo zomsebenzi (ngokwesibonelo abadobi nezinhlangano zokuphanda nezokutakula), nabanye ababamba iqhaza kwezemidlalo ehlobene nolwandle nemisebenzi yokuzilibazisa efana nokuntweza, ukugwedla, noma ukubhukuda.
Hausa: Waɗannan sun haɗa da mutanen da suke amfani da hasashen yanayi don dalilai na aiki (misali masunta da ƙungiyoyin bincike da kuma ceto), da sauran waɗanda suke shiga cikin wasannin da suka shafi teku da abubuwan nishaɗi kamar hawan igiyar ruwa, tudun ruwa, ko kuma iyo.
Northern Sotho: Bona ba akareditše bašomi ba dikakanyo tša boso go phethagatša mešomo (mohlala go thuša barei ba dihlapi le mekgatlo ya go nyaka le ya phološo), le ba bangwe bao ba kgathago tema go dipapadi tše di amanago le tša ka lewatleng le mediro ya boithabišo e bjalo ka go sesa, go jagela maotwana, goba go rutha.

Source: Researchers asked about how easy a preferred weather forecasting service was to use, and how accurate and consistent its predictions were.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baabuuza ku bwangu obwali mu kukozesa obuweereza bw’enteebereza y’obudde ey’engeri emu, n’obutuufu bw’ebyo ebiteeberezebwa.

Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች ተመራጭ የአየር ሁኔታ ትንበያ አገልግሎትን ለመጠቀም እንዴት ለመጠቀም ቀላል እንደሆነ፣ እና ትንበያዎቹ ምን ያህል ትክክለኛ እና ተከታታይ እንደሆኑ ጠይቀዋል።

Source: Participants listed the factors that made it more useful and important to them and said whether these might change because of climate change.
Luganda: Abeetabi baalaga ensonga ezaali zigifuula ey’omugaso gye bali era ne boogera oba nga bino biyinza okukyuka olw’enkyukakyuka mu mbeera y’obudde.

Source: Most South Africans who took part in the study were surfers, or people who helped with search and rescue operations or research projects.
Luganda: Banna-South Afirika abasinga abeetaba mu kunoonyereza kuno baali batambulira ku mayengo ga bwato, babonzi ba maato oba abantu abayambako mu mulimu gw’okunoonya n’okutaasa oba mu pulojekiti z’okunoonyereza.

Zulu: Iningi labantu baseNingizimu Afrika ababambe iqhaza ocwaningweni kwakungabatshuzi, noma abantu abasiza ngemisebenzi yophenyo nokuhlenga noma amaphrojekthi ocwaningo.

Northern Sotho: Bontši bja Maafrika Borwa bao ba kgathilego tema ka dinyakišišong e be e le baruthi, goba batho ao ba thušitšego ka mešomo ya go nyaka le go phološa goba go diprotšeke tša dinyakišišo.

Source: Most New Zealanders who answered the questions looked at weather forecasts because they wanted to go fishing, sail a boat or paddle out to sea.
